title: Coupled elementary estimates and certified prime chain: universal11.5213 remainder

claims.statement: Joint CircuitBreaker theorem under rules.md: the following declaration defines ONE fixed eligible total uniform NP family in the pinned full B2 model at actual input length n. Its full guarantee and its declared projection both hold unconditionally, for all sufficiently large integer lengths with the quantifiers specified by the theorem kinds. Both score source claims assert this ENTIRE declaration, not separate lemmas. For g(n)=c*n^p*(log2 n)^q*(log2 log2 n)^r with the exact parameters in guarantee, liminf over all integer n of C_B2(f_n)/g(n) >= 1. Equivalently, for every epsilon>0 there is N_epsilon such that C_B2(f_n)>=(1-epsilon)*g(n) for every integer n>=N_epsilon. Declaration: {"convention":"uniform-np-full-b2-actual-length-all-lengths-v1","family":"The single total deterministic-field family defined by proof.md and family.py. At actual length N enumerate primes2<=k<=N, r=ceil(N/k) and r-1 with r>=3,k>r+1, m=min(N,rk), ignored p=N-m, and2<=t<r. Use d=H+E0+1 from disperser.md Sections12--13, B=t(t+3)/2<=d<m, and choose the minimum(4p+8d-4B-3,k,t,p) including the zero option(4N,0,0,0). Construct Q_k by the supplied deterministic prime-degree specialization of Shoup in field.md and irreducible_prime(k), ignore p actual input bits, and evaluate the descending-power order-t symmetric polynomial on the remaining m bits over F2[Z]/Q_k with zero padding. No field-polynomial bits or advice are inputs.","guarantee":{"coefficient":{"denominator":"1","numerator":"4"},"exponent":{"denominator":"1","numerator":"1"},"kind":"polynomial_log","log_exponent":{"denominator":"1","numerator":"0"},"loglog_exponent":{"denominator":"1","numerator":"0"}},"projection":{"coefficient":{"denominator":"1","numerator":"4"},"exponent":{"denominator":"1","numerator":"1"},"kind":"finite"},"theorem":"This ONE fixed total deterministic-field language is in uniform P, hence NP with empty witnesses. The supplied prime-degree constructor, PRIME-DEGREE coefficient-isolation/zero-deficit theorem and full-B2 elimination establish C_B2(F_N)>=4N-L_N at EVERY actual integer N>=0 for the exact total selector in family.py. Sections8--10 prove for EVERY integer N>=0 that L_N<=(115213/10000)N^(4/5), hence C_B2(F_N)>=4N-(115213/10000)N^(4/5). Section8 supplies coupled elementary psi bounds and a prime in(x,(11669/10000)x] for every real x>=2^47. Sections9--10 supply all guards, analytic tail N>=2^79, zero range0..198,6484 checked finite rows for199..2^30-1 and a reproduced2596-entry finite prime chain covering EVERY real argument2^18..2^48 to treat the entire middle2^30<=N<2^79. Every chain entry is checked by independent trial division or the supplied proved Proth criterion. Endpoint concavity and chain ratio coverage prove all interiors; no samples are extrapolated beyond their verified ranges. Thus for every epsilon>0 and all sufficiently large integer N, C_B2(F_N)>=(4-epsilon)N. The four finite six-entry loss tuples are numeric certified-loss comparisons only. No prior verdict, accepted-result catalog, external prime-gap theorem or circuit upper bound is a premise.","version":"circuitbreaker-expression-v1"}

claims: For every ODD PRIME k>=3, the exact irreducible_prime(k) algorithm in family.py terminates in polynomial time in k and outputs a monic irreducible binary polynomial of degree k. field.md supplies the complete prime-degree construction and proof, including binary factor extraction, cyclotomic nonresidue lifting, Kummer extension and trace descent. This specializes a known Shoup construction and does not claim a new general irreducible-construction algorithm.

The complete finite certified losses(original,weighted,positive-exact,zero-deficit,compressed,new) are(1461,1437,1429,1413,1393,1257) at N=500,(2533,2493,2485,2485,2465,2265) at N=1000,(4513,4449,4433,4417,4397,4061) at N=2000,and(16809,16601,16577,16521,16501,15365) at N=10000. These compare certified losses, not actual optimal circuit sizes.

For EVERY integer N>=0 this SAME fixed total uniform P family satisfies C_B2(F_N)>=4N-(115213/10000)N^(4/5). Sections8--10 supply the complete coupled-psi prime lemma, analytic tail, zero range and finite-coverage transfers. The declared computation checks6484 intervals for199..2^30-1 and a2596-entry prime chain with trial division or proved Proth witnesses covering EVERY real argument2^18..2^48. No untested infinite range is inferred from samples.

experiments.purpose: Generate and independently verify6484 finite intervals and the2596-entry prime chain, checking exact primality witnesses, guards, endpoint predicates, consecutive/ratio coverage and rational analytic constants. Retain foundational bounded field/threshold/reference/evaluator predicates. Universal transfer and prime lemmas are supplied proofs.
